title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum delivers a fun, fruity vape with a sweet retro twist. Ripe Strawberry leads with its familiar summery sweetness, while Watermelon adds a fresh, juicy lift. The Bubblegum rounds off the blend with a sugary, nostalgic flavour that ties the fruits together with a soft, confectionery-inspired note. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides fast-acting nicotine delivery, and a smoother, more comfortable throat hit. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens, the 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent vapour and vibrant flavour throughout the day. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
